description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: Give me N fresh time-sortable identifiers (UUID v7 or ULID). Mints 1-100 UUID v7 (RFC 9562) or ULID identifiers per call from the server's CSPRNG and clock; ids from one call are strictly increasing. Informational mint only: not a proof of uniqueness across other issuers, not a secret or credential; the embedded time is this server's clock. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
